text: APPROVE. The ternary and the extracted `AnnotatedArrowParameterClose` return the same `close` value as the old if/else for every input (including `arrow == 0`), and the final lookup is unchanged. Both methods are well under 15 in cognitive complexity (roughly 4 and 8), and the new private static helper, its well-formed XML doc, and the existing `MaxReturnTypeTokens` constant should build cleanly.
